summary: Comprehensive testing of Tactics page TV-style pitch view, auto-save, formation picker, messenger network contacts, and bottom nav visibility. All features working correctly. Backend: 8/8 tests passed. Frontend: All UI elements verified.
seed_data_creation: Used existing Storm G14 team with 11 players for tactics page testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All P0-P1 features verified working: 1) Tactics page uses TVPitchView component with dark background (#1A1D23), 2) Red player dots with name labels (first name small, last name bold), 3) Auto-save triggers 800ms after assignment changes with 'Saved' indicator, 4) Formation picker works with 4 formations (3-3-2, 3-2-3, 2-3-2-1, 2-4-1), 5) Messenger shows network contacts in horizontal bar, 6) Bottom nav visible on Dashboard/Messages/Calendar/Network pages.
